title: Validating the Submission Confidence Index
text: checks use single evidence table spread domains, severities, results. Everything built base data frames article fully reproducible.
code: make_evidence <- function(domain, severity, result, id_prefix = "IND") {   ctx <- suppressMessages(     r4subcore::r4sub_run_context(study_id = "VALDEMO", environment = "DEV")   )   df <- data.frame(     asset_type       = "dataset",     asset_id         = "ADSL",     source_name      = "demo",     indicator_id     = paste0(id_prefix, "-", seq_along(result)),     indicator_name   = paste("check", seq_along(result)),     indicator_domain = domain,     severity         = severity,     result           = result,     stringsAsFactors = FALSE   )   suppressMessages(r4subcore::as_evidence(df, ctx = ctx)) }  domains    <- rep(c("quality", "trace", "risk", "usability"), each = 5) severities <- rep(c("info", "low", "medium", "high", "critical"), times = 4) results    <- rep("pass", 20)  evidence <- make_evidence(domains, severities, results) compute_sci(compute_pillar_scores(evidence))$SCI #> [1] 50

code: fractions <- seq(0, 0.9, by = 0.1)  gradient <- lapply(fractions, function(f) {   res <- rep("pass", 20)   n_fail <- round(f * 20)   if (n_fail > 0) res[seq_len(n_fail)] <- "fail"   ev <- make_evidence(domains, severities, res)   data.frame(     fraction_failed = f,     SCI             = compute_sci(compute_pillar_scores(ev))$SCI,     findings        = conformance_findings(ev)   ) }) gradient <- do.call(rbind, gradient) gradient #>    fraction_failed  SCI findings #> 1              0.0 50.0     0.00 #> 2              0.1 37.8     0.25 #> 3              0.2 32.5     1.50 #> 4              0.3 27.5     2.50 #> 5              0.4 21.2     3.25 #> 6              0.5 20.0     5.00 #> 7              0.6 11.2     5.25 #> 8              0.7  7.5     6.50 #> 9              0.8  4.5     7.50 #> 10             0.9  0.8     8.25 # Spearman rank correlation between the SCI and the independent finding count. cor(gradient$SCI, gradient$findings, method = "spearman") #> [1] -1

Add indicator_contributions(), breaks pillar score per-indicator contributions, ranks indicators many SCI points fix recover, attaches short remediation hint one. Add sci_what_if(), recomputes pillar score SCI exactly one indicator different score, planning remediation. Add sci_confidence_interval(), bootstrap confidence interval SCI readiness decision can account measurement noise, format_sci_ci() helper compact SCI = 82.0 [76.0, 88.0] form print method flags interval straddles two decision bands. Document confidence-interval interpretation scoring vignette. Add vignette: “Case study: scoring CDISC pilot submission readiness”, worked walkthrough SCI example pharma evidence r4subdata. Add validation helpers: sci_degradation_curve() records SCI responds passing checks turned failures, sci_monotone_check() confirms curve never rises, conformance_findings() produces independent severity-weighted finding count concurrent-validity checks. Add vignette: “Validating Submission Confidence Index”, covering construct, discriminant, concurrent, robustness validity, documenting calibration finding severity discounts passing credit. Clarified package DESCRIPTION: “R4SUB” expands “Ready Submission” (previously “R Regulatory Submission”, inconsistent rest ecosystem).
